purpose: Reduce the visible catch-up jump when a buffered scroll exceeds the cached reserve.

behavior.bufferedTravel: Clamp total travel relative to the last presented frame anchor; discard unseen overshoot.
behavior.smallScroll: Immediate native 1:1 cached transport within the reserve.
behavior.clouds: Apply the same accepted displacement as snow.
behavior.scrollContainer: Reanchor the held frame to the new scroll origin without advancing scene time.
behavior.limitation: The cached plane can still hold at its reserve edge until the next capture; this change removes the subsequent catch-up jump.

baseline.test: large scroll bursts reanchor the already visible held scene without a catch-up jump

candidateAssertions: Visible held particle reprojection error remains below 0.02 CSS px across large bursts and reversals.
Small eight-pixel scrolling remains immediate after a burst.
Cloud travel matches accepted snow travel with no deferred catch-up.
Changing the scroll container rebases the held frame without moving scene time.
Large running bursts keep 11-13 captures over 60 simulated display frames.
Paused scene time and layer samples stay fixed; backing dimensions and canvas count remain unchanged.

initialFullSuiteFailure.test: production: manual themes persist until the system changes and preserve active or paused snow
initialFullSuiteFailure.description: After reload, expected the stored light theme but received dark. The theme implementation is unchanged by this patch.
initialFullSuiteFailure.followUp: All five theme-toggle tests passed on a separate rerun without source changes. The initial failure is retained as an intermittent validation result; no cause is claimed.

environment.note: Temporary Playwright config preserved the project settings and used /dev/shm for test output; source hashes stayed fixed.

coverage.note: Coverage combines 45 passes in the initial full run with five theme-toggle rerun passes and five previously unexecuted theme-transition passes. It is not a single uninterrupted all-green run.

review.independentCodeReview: No must-fix issues found; residual cache-edge hold documented.
review.themeFailureReadOnlyReview: The unchanged theme bootstrap and Portfolio own root theme and storage updates; the modified engine does not write either. No direct causal path from this patch was found, and no specific cause of the intermittent initial failure is claimed.

rendering.clock: 60Hz deterministic steps; paused simulation, native scroll and 12fps held-frame capture
rendering.method: Same frozen scene and inputs in the baseline and candidate offline standalone HTML. Text hidden with visibility only to retain page layout and isolate background movement.
